desc:
Start as a tiny fish. Eat, grow and evolve into a beast!

🐟 Eat, grow and evolve through 7 tiers of ocean life
🦈 Become a Great White, Orca, Crocodile and 160+ more animals
🌊 Explore coral reefs, frozen arctic seas, swamps and deep trenches
🐙 Team up with friends to take down the Kraken and other giant bosses
🎣 Dodge fishermen, nets, and hostile divers
✨ Collect hundreds of real-life skins and pets that fight by your side

Will you eat, or be eaten?
